content:
想要更沉浸式的 Wynncraft 遊戲體驗嗎？厭倦了在解任務時必須閱讀對話了嗎？那麼 Voices of Wynn 就是為你打造的模組！在數百名志願者多年努力下，如今它為 Wynncraft 中幾乎所有 130 多個任務加入了配音！

[![圖片](https://mythicmanor.com/wp-content/uploads/Mythic-Manor-Discord-Wide-Button.png)](https://discord.gg/voices-of-wynn-814401551292563477)
     [![Patreon](https://mythicmanor.com/wp-content/uploads/2018/06/Mythic-Manor-Patreon-Button.png)](https://www.patreon.com/Voices_Of_Wynn)
